task.title: Build 65 Strength attempt: 9:38 AM window was a client-to-edge network-path stall, not a Server or reconciliation-specific fault

result.summary: Correlated the Founder's 2026-09-27 ~09:38 America/Los_Angeles (16:38 UTC) Build 65 Strength attempt -- which failed with -999 and taskWasCancelledAtCatch=false while Home/Goals reads timed out with -1001 at the same time -- against the Server's application log, a zero-write command_receipts/security_events read, deployment/restart history, and live DNS/TLS/ingress/latency probes. Findings: the Server served every request it received in the window quickly (max 1.7 s DB time, pool never queued, no errors beyond a routine expired-token 401 followed by a successful refresh), with no deployment or restart since 2026-09-26 22:39 UTC. The Home reads the device reported as timed out DID reach the Server and completed there -- six times in under three minutes (16:38:15, :32, :47, 16:39:17, 16:40:00, 16:40:56), the signature of a client abandoning responses on a 15-second idle timeout and re-requesting. Three HealthKit ingest POSTs from the same device committed at 16:38:16/32/36, and tiny evidence-review reads succeeded at 16:38:39/41 and 16:39:19, bracketing a 30-second and a 41-second gap with zero trace of the reconciliation command anywhere upstream of the application (no receipt, no request log, no security event; still 0 reconciliation receipts all-time). The path is physiqueos.dustinginn.com -> DO App Platform hostname -> Cloudflare edge (HTTP/2, alt-svc h3 advertised; TLS valid to Dec 7; live probes 150-320 ms). Native uses URLSession.shared with no custom configuration, a 15 s idle timeout on both bulk reads and the command POST, and a shared connection pool -- so when a multi-megabyte read connection stalls and idle-times-out (-1001), the in-flight command on the same connection is reported cancelled (-999) with the Swift Task untouched, which is exactly why the Build 65 background-execution assertion (which guards against app suspension, not a dead connection) could not help. The app pulls 4-10 MB Home/Goals/Log/check-in payloads immediately after foregrounding, and every real reconciliation attempt has been made inside that burst. No fix implemented, no build cut, no retry requested, per instruction.

zero_write_audit.summary: Owner-scoped, REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY, transaction_read_only=on verified, ROLLBACK-guaranteed read of command_receipts (16:18-16:58 UTC window, same-day by type, all-time reconciliation) and security_events (16:00-17:00 UTC). Application log pulled read-only via doctl apps logs; deployment list and run_restarted log read-only; DNS/TLS/HTTP probes against public health endpoints only.

server_health_in_window.summary: All reads served; max DB elapsedMs 1744; no elapsedMs >= 3 s anywhere in the retained log; DB pool waitingCount>0 only at 03:24, 14:37, 14:39, 14:43 UTC (never in the window); single boot marker since 22:38 UTC 9/26; run_restarted log empty; ingress unchanged.

unexpected_findings: The device's 'timed out' Home/Goals reads were produced by the Server -- repeatedly -- and never received: the failure lived between the Cloudflare edge and the phone, not at the origin.

Native's bulk reads (4-10 MB responses) and its 1 KB command POST share one URLSession.shared connection pool and the same 15 s idle timeout; a stalled read connection can and did take the write down with it as a -999.

alt-svc h3 is advertised by the edge, so iOS may be using HTTP/3/QUIC (UDP) on the phone; whether it was, and on which interface, is not knowable from the Server side -- the one open question this evidence cannot close.
backlog: Recommended (not implemented): a dedicated URLSession for command POSTs (waitsForConnectivity, longer resource timeout) so a stalled bulk-read connection cannot cancel a write.

Recommended (not implemented): shrink/paginate the 4-10 MB Home, Goals, Log and morning-check-in payloads -- the 15 s idle timeout makes every heavy screen fragile on a weak link, not just reconciliation.

Recommended (not implemented): capture URLSessionTaskMetrics + NWPath (protocol h2/h3, interface, DNS/connect/TLS timings) at failure so the next natural attempt answers the HTTP/3-on-lossy-link question before any opt-out decision.
No Cloudflare/App Platform edge access logs are reachable via doctl; the Server-side correlation is as far as ingress visibility goes without additional access.
Two ChatGPT master-thread-context handoffs remain unread in the inbox, staying scoped exactly to this task as instructed.
recommended_next_step: Do not solicit another Strength attempt. When a fix is authorized, prioritize the shared-connection/write-path separation and payload-size reductions (they address every screen's -1001s, not just reconciliation), and add the task-metrics/path capture so the next natural attempt closes the h3/interface question.
